summary: Prompt 7 (Timetable Engine + Proxy Scheduling) validated. Backend pytest suite is 201/201 PASS (includes test_timetable.py 29 cases — grid CRUD, conflict detection, publish lifecycle/locking, proxy dashboard, recommendations, substitutions workflow, proxy config, tenant isolation). Frontend smoke test confirms all three new pages (/school/timetable, /school/timetable/proxy, /school/timetable/proxy-config) load for a freshly registered school owner, sidebar nav links work, grid pickers render, proxy dashboard shows the 'All teachers accounted for' empty state when no absences, and proxy-config inputs persist across reload (cutoff_time, max_proxy_per_day_per_teacher, prefer_same_grade toggle verified).
critical_code_review_comments: Registration form currently rejects .test TLD (reserved per Pydantic email-validator). This is correct behavior but the UI shows the raw 422 with no inline error on the Register page — consider surfacing a friendly inline error. Not a P7 blocker.

Full end-to-end UI test of grid cell editor, conflict detection modal, publish/lock badge transitions, and proxy recommendations dialog requires substantial seeded data (class, section, subjects, rooms, bell schedule with periods, teachers with timetable slots, approved leaves). These flows are already deterministically covered by the 29 timetable backend tests; UI was verified via smoke test only.
test_credentials: Fresh school owner registered dynamically per run (e.g. owner-zpdrpm@example.com / SchoolOwner@123). Note: .test TLD rejected by backend email validator — use example.com.
seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond the registration-created tenant. Backend tests self-seed and self-clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression (201/201) + Prompt 7 timetable suite (29 cases) are green. Frontend pages exist with correct data-testids. For deeper UI coverage of grid editor/conflicts/publish/proxy-recommendations, seed via API: create class → section → subjects → rooms → bell schedule (with periods) → teacher users → optional leave approval. Then open /school/timetable, pick year+bell+section, click tt-cell-{weekday}-{period_no} and interact with cell-subject/cell-teacher/cell-room/cell-save. Email registration requires non-reserved TLD (example.com not .test).
